token.description: Only the initial response contains the token; it is never recoverable.

MachineSessionView.description: Public identity of this verified machine credential, never a secret lookup.

Revision.description: Canonical decimal string in the PostgreSQL signed bigint range; nonnegative counters or positive revisions.

BrowserSession.description: Native private cookie; browser writes require exact same-origin Origin. Explicit loopback development uses quazonai-dev.
BrowserSession.name: __Host-quazonai

MachineBearer.description: Opaque native capability; only project/run/downstream-scoped server records confer authority. Never combine with browser Cookie.

OperatorCommandGrant.description: One-time TOTP-verified CLI grant bound to this credential, exact operation, target and full nonsecret request. No Agent/automation grant issuance.
OperatorCommandGrant.name: X-Operator-Grant

tags.description: Native TOTP and revocable browser sessions
